crisp_relief.why: off: the template gate needs the graph lift, which cannot carry crisp_relief yet; the ground is round domes with no steep height-field wall

draft_clamp.why: lost wax at min_draft 0: no layer is clamped, so no bite is taken; the hide is decals over the bare band

notes: Lost wax: 4.14% of the surface would undercut a two-part pull (worst 29.8 deg) — fine for investment, but this pattern cannot move to sand as-is.
Undercut 83–27° on the crest: 51.5 mm² leaning to 29° — caused by "Gila beadwork"; muting it clears it.
Undercut 47–47° on the upper shoulder: 0.1 mm² leaning to 1° — caused by "Gila beadwork"; muting it clears it.
Undercut 54–76° on the crest: 3.2 mm² leaning to 10° — caused by "Gila beadwork"; muting it clears it.
1 made setting cast in place with the ring; the field judges the band under it.
Measured with the ring as built: 1 CAD part (1 joined, 0 cut), 312.2 mm² of part surface; under lost wax they are reported, never gating.
Lost wax: Stored mesh "Gila" (#1) would undercut a two-part pull over 68.6 mm² (worst -89°) — fine for investment, but this pattern cannot move to sand as-is.

gates.gate: solids notes empty, every stamp resolved
lost-wax field verdict Castable with the 0.8 mm fill
land widths at the floor or named, every load-bearing feature measured
ray release recorded at 0.100 and 0.075 mm (lost wax: not applicable)
draft clamp: none applied, every bite 0 mm

land_widths.bead_note: relief beads on the band, judged at the detail floor: each is a dome over at least the band's own 2.7 mm section

made_parts.treatment: the collet's wall and lip: the lip is burnished over the spessartite's girdle at the bench; the wall below it stands on the mound, sunk 0.35 mm into it, so the investment fills it from the mound's own section

made_parts.claw_note: the claw tips are rounded ends 0.52 mm across: named under the 0.8 mm floor, filled from the 0.8 mm toe behind each

features.feature: collet lip beads (round domes on the mound)

made_parts.lip_note: the collet lip's beads are relief domes 0.4 mm across sitting on the mound, judged at the detail floor like the ground's beads
made_parts.method: twice the inscribed radius the sculpt's own field reads along each feature's axis

made_parts.treatment: named, not removed: the rays that read under the floor cut chords through the bead relief (domes and seams on a body 2.6 mm or more through), the claw tips and the eye sockets; every load-bearing feature is measured above, per feature

ray_release.why: lost wax: the pattern is burnt out of the investment, never withdrawn; the release reads NotApplicable, and its two-part counts are what the ring would meet in sand, reported like the two-part undercut
